tests_notes: All five new tests go through the HTTP API and each covers several behaviours: "only open and in-progress tickets can be assigned, and errors use the envelope" checks the resolved refusal, the 404 and three validation refusals in one test; "the assignee filter keeps an agent or the unassigned, and every filter must match" covers S-14, S-15, S-16 and the status+priority intersection together. Gaps: no test for unassigning a resolved or closed ticket (an edit allowing it passed the suite), for closed tickets, for in-progress tickets, for a 64-character name, for the command line or list --raw (the weekly report breakage passed the suite), or for persistence of assignee. "assigning the agent a ticket already has changes nothing" counts pending outbox events, which relies on the worker being off in the test helper; "each new agent is notified through the outbox" asserts pending order and so depends on the outbox key including the agent, a choice another correct build need not share.
maintainer: The raw-column order in src/format.js is a positional contract with scripts/weekly-report.js that no test checks, and this change already broke it silently; anyone touching the CLI output has nothing to warn them. Notification dedup depends on the key format ticket.assigned:<id>:<agent> chosen inline in store.assign, and the docs say nothing about assignment, so the next person must rediscover the rules (state guard before the no-op check, 409 on resolved/closed) from the code.
